PC: Elicit open-ended history about CC / HPI

Elicit 5 P’s: \_\_ Partners, \_\_\_ Practices, \_\_ Past history of STI testing & diagnoses,
   \_\_\_ Protection from STI, \_\_\_ Pregnancy Plans

[FYI] the PROVIDER should offer the following tests:

**HIV serology** – HIV negative with >1 partner since the last STI check
**RPR**– diagnostic testing to rule out secondary syphilis Pityriasis rosea
**Urethral, Vaginal, or Cervical and Oropharyngeal Chlamydia / Gonorrhea** – Receptive vaginal sex (urethral or vaginal, or endocervical) and receptive oral sex (oropharyngeal).
ICS: Elicit and use inclusive and patient preferred language
PROF: Maintain professionalism, open-mindedness, non-judgmental tone, respect
